faqs.question: What does 💕🦋 mean when sent twice?
faqs.answer: Sending 💕🦋 twice intensifies the flirt. It usually reads as "I really do mean it" and is best reserved for recipients who already escalated with you first.

faqs.question: Is 💕🦋 acceptable on a wedding invite?
faqs.answer: No. Wedding-coded communication tends to be formal, and the flirting cue is the wrong register. Reach for a sentence and a single soft emoji.

faqs.question: Can 💕🦋 be a sign of interest?
faqs.answer: 💕🦋 is one of the clearest signs of interest in emoji form. The two emojis are picked specifically to communicate attraction, which is why the read is consistent across platforms.

faqs.question: What does 💕🦋 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl, 💕🦋 is the same flirting-coded cue. There is no gendered reading — the combo reads as flirty regardless of who sends it.
